description: Database query optimization: Add missing indexes identified in Prisma schema analysis, fix potential N+1 queries in list operations, and verify query performance with EXPLAIN.
steps: Review prisma/schema.prisma for missing indexes on foreign keys and common query patterns. Current indexes cover: User(roleId, teamId, status), Lead(ownerId+status, teamId+status, campaignId+status, primaryMobile, nextFollowUpAt), CallLog(createdAt, dispositionId+createdAt, agentId+startedAt), FollowUp(ownerId+status+dueAt), Session(userId, expiresAt), AuditLog(entityType+entityId, actorId+createdAt).

Add missing indexes: User(reportingToId) for manager queries, LeadActivity(type, createdAt) for timeline, CallEvent(status, receivedAt) for webhook processing, Notification(userId, status, createdAt) composite already exists but verify, Attendance(userId, date) composite already unique, ImportBatch(uploadedById, createdAt) for history.

Audit services for N+1 queries: Check services/lead-service.ts listLeads() - already includes owner/team/source/campaign in select, getLeadDetail() - uses Promise.all for parallel queries (good). Check services/workspace-service.ts getWorkspaceHome() - uses Promise.all, rankQueue() operates on in-memory array after single query (good). Check services/call-service.ts listCalls() - includes lead/agent/team/disposition/recording in select (good).
Fix any N+1 in report generation: services/report-service.ts buildReport() performance case - queries attendance separately after getting agent stats, should use Promise.all if both are independent.
Add Prisma query logging in development: Update lib/db.ts to enable log: ['query'] in PrismaClient constructor when NODE_ENV=development to surface slow queries.
Test with demo data: Run npm run db:seed:demo to load 300 leads, then profile common queries with logging enabled.
Generate migration for new indexes: npm run db:migrate dev --name add-performance-indexes after schema updates.
Document query optimization patterns in ARCHITECTURE.md.
acceptance_criteria: All foreign keys have indexes where queried (User.reportingToId, others verified present)
No N+1 queries in list/detail pages (verified with Prisma query log)
Common filter columns have indexes (status+date combinations, createdAt ranges)
Migration file generated and applied successfully
Page load times for lists with 1000+ records under 500ms (measure with demo data)
verification: Enable Prisma query logging in lib/db.ts, run npm run dev, navigate to /leads and /calls pages, verify query log shows single batched queries not N loops
Use psql EXPLAIN ANALYZE on generated queries to verify index usage
npm run test:integration to ensure no query regressions
findings: Schema has good baseline indexes but missing some for reporting queries. No obvious N+1 in core paths (list operations use include properly). Prisma query logging not enabled. Performance never measured. Report generation could benefit from parallel queries. Missing indexes: User(reportingToId), LeadActivity(type, createdAt), CallEvent(status, receivedAt), ImportBatch(uploadedById, createdAt).
